ai.overview: AS Roma hold the lineal championship belt and will defend it for the ninth time in this reign when they host Cagliari Calcio on 2026-10-27. The belt passes to whoever wins, with no polls or committees involved—just the result on the pitch. Cagliari arrive riding a three-game winning streak, while Roma saw their four-game winning run end with a 2–2 draw against Inter Milan.
key_matchups: Roma's recent offensive firepower (4–0 vs Fiorentina, 4–0 at Lecce) versus Cagliari's stingy defense riding three straight 1–0 and 2–1 victories
Cagliari's three-game winning streak against Roma's unbeaten home form this season
Historical dominance favors Roma 42–20 in the all-time series, but the last five meetings have been tightly contested
ai.betting_angles: Roma enter as clear Elo favorites and hold a 4-0-1 record this season, while Cagliari sit at 4-1. The all-time head-to-head favors Roma 42–20 across 90 meetings, though recent encounters have been competitive with three of the last five decided by a single goal or ending scoreless. Roma's attacking form showed four goals in back-to-back wins before the Inter draw, while Cagliari have won their last 3 games by narrow 1–0 and 2–1 margins.
ai.prediction_writeup: Roma have been dominant at home and showed their attacking quality with consecutive 4–0 victories over Fiorentina and Lecce earlier in the season. Cagliari's recent wins have all come by the slimmest of margins, and historically they've struggled in this matchup with Roma holding a commanding 42–20 edge. The Elo model backs Roma as clear favorites, and their 4-0-1 record suggests they'll bounce back from the Inter draw. Roma have successfully defended the belt 8 times already in this reign, and playing at home against a side they beat 2–0 in the most recent meeting earlier this year, they should extend that streak to 9.
